member.name: ConsoleColors
member.para: The terminfo measurement. Verified 2026-07-29 on Debian under WSL2: the stock xterm entry advertises colors#8, against xterm-256color's colors#0x100. Under it emits SGR 30, plain black.

member.name: TerminalNamesColorSupport
member.para: Why $COLORTERM is not consulted. Measured 2026-07-29: COLORTERM=truecolor TERM=xterm renders the bar's dark grey as SGR 30, plain black - i.e. honoring $COLORTERM produces exactly the unreadable output the check exists to prevent.
